mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 7.5% signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE falls below 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% monthly growth indicate strong consumer demand, driving corporate profit expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 0.5% MoM and RSAFS increases > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 0.5% MoM growth.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (INDPRO > 100) indicates manufacturing expansion, increasing corporate output and profit margins, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100.

mechanism_narrative: Employment levels above 130,000 (PAYEMS > 130000) indicate a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 130000.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate rise above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) above 0.3% monthly growth indicate broad economic expansion, accelerating corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 0.3% MoM and PAYEMS increases > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both INDPRO and PAYEMS exceed 0.3% MoM growth.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 900 (HOUST > 900) signals housing market recovery, increasing consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 900.
